topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing and introduces the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen recognition, molecular patterns, and PRR signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the innate immune system detects infection and tissue damage using molecular patterns and various families of pattern recognition receptors.

topics.label: Inflammatory activation, cellular recruitment, and systemic consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how sentinel cells initiate the inflammatory response, mobilize leukocytes to affected tissues, coordinate with the lymphatic system, and potentially trigger severe systemic complications.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the mechanisms that resolve acute inflammation, facilitate tissue repair, and lead to chronic inflammatory adaptations such as granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks and announces the subject of the following lecture.
